'''Galactic Frontier''' was Players Committee '''Virtual Set 15''' in the pre&ndash;September 2009 numbered Virtual program. Overview and confidence notes: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Era map: [[History of the Players Committee]]. Icon shorthand used on these sheets: [[Virtual card icons]].

== Cover pack / set symbol ==

Players Committee printed Virtual set covers with pack mockups and set marks for the later numbered Virtual sheets (same visual family as the Dec 2006 Remaster / Re-edit covers for earlier sets). Cover pack art and circular set symbol from the same printable sheet. IA Resources/VirtualCards15.pdf CDX empty; CDN legacyblocks used.

Narrative tip (Bill/Chief): PC remade Virtual cards to look nicer for this cover-pack wave &mdash; framing matches [[Virtual Set 1 (Original)]] / [[Virtual Set 16 (Original)]] treatment. Do not invent symbol meanings beyond the PDF ICON KEY / cover (see [[Virtual card icons]]).

== Card list ==

Titles, numbers, sides, and types as printed on VirtualCards15.pdf slips (Official text as of March 21, 2008). Slip images cropped from that PDF. Game text on each stub is transcribed from the PDF (ICON KEY expansions documented on each stub) &mdash; not invented. Cover pack art shows '''67 CARD EXPANSION SET'''; no errata card-number note on cover. Where the Virtual slip title differs from the Decipher footer base, the stub uses the Virtual title and notes the Decipher base.

== Provenance ==

Primary cover PDF used for pack and set symbol on this hub:

* CDN day-to-day: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf VirtualCards15.pdf]
* Wayback Resources/VirtualCards15.pdf: no application/pdf binary recovered (see hunt notes on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] / Alpha1 VC Original packs report)

After the 2009 Block reorganization these cards were regrouped into [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]] / Legacy packaging; framing, errata, and legality can differ. Do not invent card text on this stub.
